fence.name: Fence
fence.description: Right-click: a fence panel across your view, 2 bricks high, posts 3 studs apart. Keeps out zombies and pigs (anything that steps only one brick). Panels side by side share posts.

tall_fence.name: Tall fence
tall_fence.description: Right-click: a fence panel 3 bricks high. For animals that jump two bricks.
